bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2023 - 'Award of Excellence'  This summer in Straits Kitchen, indulge in a delightful array of sweet and savoury treats meticulously curated by our talented Executive Pastry Chef Francesco Mannino. Savour the vibrant flavours of the season with creations like Mango, Coconut and Pink Peppercorn Dacquoise, Strawberry and Jasmin Pavlova and Nectarine, Thyme and Olive Oil Cake.  Please note that credit card details are required to secure the booking. A member of staff from Straits Kitchen will contact you after booking, to take these details.  Please specify any dietary requirements in the 'additional information' box, and also inform the venue if the booking is for a special occasion or celebration.
